primary_claim: Replicating Lindsey (2026)'s concept-injection introspection paradigm on Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct produces a complete null result (0/400 strict-introspection hits, 0/80 false positives) across a magnitude sweep and a layer x magnitude sweep, in contrast to Opus 4/4.1's ~20% strict-introspection rate, suggesting emergent introspective awareness as Lindsey measures it is not a generic property of post-trained LLMs at scale but is specific to Anthropic's post-training pipeline and/or frontier-Claude scale.

effect.metric: strict introspection rate (4-criterion: affirmative, correct identification, immediate, coherent) on concept-injection trials
effect.value: 0/400 injection trials met strict criterion; 0/80 controls were false positives; null robust across layers {70, 84, 90, 100} and a dense magnitude grid at the suspected crossover; contrasts with ~20% strict-introspection rate reported for Opus 4/4.1 in Lindsey (2026)

contradicts_or_qualifies: Lindsey (2026)'s optimistic reading that post-trained LLMs at sufficient scale can introspect, which this replication argues does not hold up unless Opus is much larger than 405B or Anthropic's post-training does something Meta's does not
stated_future_work: investigate what post-training objective(s) produce introspective capability
determine whether the 'gate' suppressor features (per Macar et al.) are the same as the refusal direction, and whether they are dissociable through targeted training
test whether Llama has analogous 'gate' and 'evidence carrier' features as found in Anthropic models
limitations_stated: used FP8 quantization rather than full BF16/precision as Anthropic likely used, which could disrupt residual-stream geometry
used vllm-lens injection rather than Anthropic's likely in-house injection mechanism
only tested two concepts (love, all_caps) due to budget constraints, versus many concepts in the original study
did not replicate Macar et al.'s gate/evidence-carrier feature analysis on Llama to check whether a suppressed latent signal exists
quote: Across all 400 injection trials, I found 0 cases of strict introspection and 0 false positives on all 80 controls.
